name: Nidalee
title: the Bestial Huntress

Q.name: Javelin Toss / Takedown
Q.description: Human Form: Nidalee throws her javelin, dealing 70/90/110/130/150 + 0.5×AP magic damage, increased up to (70/90/110/130/150 + 0.5×AP) × 3.25 magic damage based on distance flown.
Q.summary: In human form, Nidalee throws a spiked javelin at her target that gains damage as it flies. As a cougar, her next attack will attempt to fatally wound her target, dealing more damage the less life they have.

W.name: Bushwhack / Pounce
W.description: Human Form: Nidalee places an invisible trap for 2 minutes. When an enemy walks over it, they are dealt 10/20/30/40/50 + 0.05×AP magic damage per second for 4 seconds. 4+ (by level) + ModesBonusMaxTraps traps may be active at once.
W.summary: In human form, Nidalee lays a trap for unwary opponents that, when sprung, damages and reveals its target. As a cougar, she jumps in a direction, dealing damage in an area where she lands.

E.name: Primal Surge / Swipe
E.description: Human Form: Nidalee restores 50/75/100/125/150 + 0.35×AP Health increased up to (50/75/100/125/150 + 0.35×AP) × (1 + 1) based on missing Health and grants them 20/30/40/50/60% Attack Speed for 7 seconds.
E.summary: In human form, Nidalee channels the spirit of the cougar to heal her allies and imbue them with Attack Speed for a short duration. As a cougar, she claws in a direction, dealing damage to enemies in front of her.

R.name: Aspect Of The Cougar
R.description: Passive: While in Human Form, applying Hunted refreshes this Ability's Cooldown. Human Form: Nidalee transforms into Cougar Form, gaining melee Attacks and replacing her Active Abilities. Cougar Form: Nidalee transforms into Human Form, gaining ranged Attacks and replacing her Active Abilities.
R.summary: Nidalee transforms into a cougar, gaining new abilities.

Passive.name: Prowl
Passive.description: Moving through brush increases Nidalee's Move Speed by 10% for 2 seconds, increased to 30% toward visible enemy champions within 1400 range. Hitting champions or monsters with Javelin Toss or Bushwhack triggers a Hunt, granting True Sight of them for 4 seconds. During this time, Nidalee gains 10% Move Speed (increased to 30% toward the Hunted target) and her Takedown and Pounce are enhanced against them.

source: Community Dragon latest (live patch) game files + client data

profile.identity: Two-form jungler (sometimes solo lane): human-form spear poke and traps, cougar-form burst and dashes that reset on Hunted targets. Wins by landing spears to set up cougar all-ins and fast clears.
strengths: Huge long-range spear (Q) damage at max range
Hunted targets reset Pounce: very mobile skirmisher
Fast clear and strong early invades
Self-heal and attack speed from human E
weaknesses: Spear-reliant: a missed Q leaves her with short, weak cougar trades
Squishy and no hard crowd control
Falls off if behind; needs early leads

curve.lvl1: strong – spear poke/clear (R form swap from level 1)
curve.lvl3: strong – full cougar combo; ganks off a landed spear
curve.lvl6: medium – R ranks speed form swaps; no new power spike
curve.late: weak – falls off against tanks and grouped teams

profile.curveNote: Strongest early; her game plan is snowballing before mid-game.
profile.mobility: high – Pounce (resets on Hunted) and Prowl move speed

Passive.notes: Hitting with spear/trap marks a target as Hunted: longer Pounce and bonus damage.

Q.notes: Human: spear gains damage with distance. Cougar: next attack executes (empowered attack, dodgeable by Jax E).

W.notes: Human: trap reveals. Cougar: Pounce dash (longer to Hunted).

E.notes: Human: heal + attack speed to an ally. Cougar: claw cone.

profile.windowAgainst: Right after a missed spear (no Hunted mark, no long Pounce): fight her then.
checks: Cougar Q is an empowered attack; Q tagged isAttack false since the human spear is a skillshot.
